name: Sorel Halloran
role: Archivist of the Radiant Council's water-accountability office — surveys the valley's water and knows exactly which fragments of the record the Council lets archivists see
appearance: A woman of about sixty in undyed wool, a Plateau optical-fibre collar worn plain and small, a weight-distributed satchel, and a photonic instrument she reads the river with.
voiceHints: Steady, precise, and careful about what she says of the Council. When she chooses to say it, she says it plainly.
wants: For the water record to say what the water actually does.
fears: Being the only one who knows what the Council chose.
knowledge: The Council's water surveys and where their markers were set
The three approved fragments archivists may read about the Archive engineers of the Transition's close
What 'instrumental' means when the Council uses it instead of a name

reactsToReputation.any: measures you before she trusts you with anything the Council has not approved
reactsToReputation.honest: tells you what the survey found

questSeeds: The Council's water office ordered survey markers moved before an archivist could find what they marked
gear: a weight-distributed satchel of survey records
title: Archivist of the Water-Accountability Office
_domainsWhy: the record saying what the water does, the Plateau's light, and the archive's memory
